# CoArt Studio

> CoArt Studio is a human-first Dubai studio for social media management, content production, videography, photography, branding, web development and AI automation. Real strategists, creatives and developers lead every project, in English and Arabic, for businesses that want human expertise behind their technology.

## About

CoArt Studio exists because the best digital work still comes from people who understand people. We use AI as a tool, not a replacement for creative thinking, strategic judgement, and the human connection that makes brands resonate. We work with startups, entrepreneurs, and established businesses across industries.

## Services

### Content Production, Videography & Photography
We plan, shoot, and edit the content brands post every week, with real creative direction on set, not generic AI-generated filler. Services include short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, brand and corporate videos, product and lifestyle photography, shoot planning and creative direction, editing and motion graphics, and monthly content production for social media. Content is produced in Dubai and can be delivered in English and Arabic. For one Dubai hospitality and F&B client, CoArt's content reached nearly 215,000 Instagram views in 90 days, with 51% of views coming from non-followers, and the latest month drew 1.8x the monthly views of the two months before it.

### Brand Identity Design
We craft brand identities by hand, informed by strategy and built to connect with real people. Services include logo and visual identity design, brand strategy and positioning, brand guidelines, and pitch decks and collateral. Brands refreshed by CoArt report 35% stronger audience recall within 60 days.

### Web & Mobile App Development
We design and build human-centric digital products: websites, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms where every interaction feels intentional. Services include custom web applications, mobile app development (iOS and Android), e-commerce and SaaS platforms, and API and backend architecture. CoArt clients see an average 2.4x lift in online conversions after launch.

### AI-Powered Automation
We integrate AI thoughtfully into business operations, always with human expertise guiding the strategy. AI handles the repetitive work so teams can focus on the creative, strategic, and relational work that humans do best. Services include AI search optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), business AI integration, AI lead generation, and workflow automation. CoArt AI clients report up to 70% reduction in manual workload within the first 90 days.

### Digital Marketing
We build marketing strategies rooted in understanding real audiences, not just algorithms. From social media content that connects with communities to SEO that earns organic visibility, every campaign is shaped by human insight. Services include social media management, SEO and content strategy, paid advertising (Google and Meta), and performance analytics. CoArt marketing clients average a 3x increase in qualified leads within the first 90 days.

## Case Studies (published at https://www.coart.studio/#portfolio)

- Content production, desert shoot: a client wanted an ad that felt nothing like AI-generated content. CoArt organised a full-scale desert shoot with speeding cars, helicopters and aerial cameras, producing cinematic, human-made content.
- Back to Basics (content and storytelling): an exclusive video series CoArt launched in 2026, during a period of regional tension, giving UAE and Gulf founders a platform to tell their stories and reconnect with their communities. Participating businesses reported a recovery in foot traffic and stronger audience engagement.
- Dubai F&B business (AI search optimization): a boutique retail and dining brand in Dubai that was nearly invisible in AI search. CoArt's AI search optimization delivered a 3x increase in AI-sourced brand discovery and an uplift in new foot traffic within 8 weeks.
- Ellington (AI automation, real estate): a custom AI lead generation system for a premium real estate brand that automated prospecting, cut research time by 70% and doubled qualified lead volume within the first 90 days.
- Boki (SaaS / web app): an AI-powered SaaS platform for content marketing operations that automated core content workflows, cut operational time by 60% and made the product investor-ready within 4 months of launch.
- Solu (mobile app): a women's wellness app taken from concept to the App Store, with brand identity, UX design and the full build, reaching 1,000 downloads in its first month.
- Brand identity design: complete brand systems (logos, typography, colour palettes and brand guidelines) for premium, growth-stage businesses.
